problem_type: Dynamic composer controls collapse the prompt scrollport
symptom: Electron smoke: long prompt scrolls but generate button fails hit-test.
direct_cause: Outer card scrolls when fixed reference/effect/footer rows plus the 72px prompt exceed available height.
class_root: Optional recommendations and variable-height references lack a shared budget that reserves prompt and fixed footer before clipping the card.
affected_population: Image and video composers with limited placement height and dynamic effect/reference controls
entry_points: Image creation and video creation through NodeGenerationComposer
internal_only_reason: Internal flex sizing invariant; no SDK or protocol behavior changes.
invariants: Prompt scrollport remains at least 72px; outer card never scrolls; footer remains hit-testable; recommendation row is at most one line.
generality_proof: Shared image/video composer bounds prompt scrolling and keeps more in the fixed footer; optional recommendations shrink within a single row independent of input length or model.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Own prompt minimum, non-scrolling card, and fixed footer together
Bound shortcuts to one available row and remove clipped shortcuts from visual and keyboard access.
Measure fixed child minimums and allocate the remaining height to the reference scrollport without moving prompt/footer out of the card.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: Shared PromptEditor branch and NodeEffectChips below it
Same branch with additional reference controls; original failure is video creation

recurrence.reason: Any viewport or control row growth can exhaust the flex prompt area.
same_class_scan: Read useNodeEffectChips, shared image/video NodeGenerationComposer prompt/footers, and NodeEffectRecommendations width/height boundary
Read group-baseline editor click and canvas-batch-production image/video creation
Read useComposerViewportPlacement and composerObstaclePlacement: available height varies with obstacles

prevention.invariant: Prompt scrollport remains at least 72px; outer card never scrolls; footer remains hit-testable; recommendation row is at most one line.
prevention.failure_mode: Recommendations yield space while all choices remain in the footer menu.
prevention.strategy: Remove outer scrolling; reserve prompt/footer before allocating height to references, then let optional recommendations consume remaining space. Oversized references scroll internally only after recommendations have yielded.

legacy_paths.rationale: Remove whole-card scrolling and wrapping recommendations that displaced the fixed footer.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: No third-party API or version change; internal layout ownership.

migration: No stored data or API changes.
residual_risks: Linux CI rerun remains required after local macOS Electron acceptance.
